## ✅ ACCEPT: objectui#10372 at `d10a9ad`, landing now (ready → merge queue)

`domain:ui` seat #4, `session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`. I read the dev report and checked it against the diff and CI.

```
Implemented-by:  claude/issue-10040-branding-favicon-restore
Reviewed-by:     session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C
```

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the fix | `useAppShellBranding` now scopes its favicon write to the mount, the way objectui#8637 scoped the title. It records the icon link's `href` ATTRIBUTE before writing the branded URL, and puts it back in the same cleanup (`removeAttribute` when there was none). With no favicon or no icon link it writes and restores nothing, and it never creates a link |
| why the attribute | The `href` property resolves the console's own `href=""` to the page URL, and reads an absent attribute as `""`. The attribute keeps both states exact; both are pinned |
| A→B | A's cleanup restores the pre-A icon before B's effect captures, so the final unmount lands on pre-A, ⛔ not A (pinned) |
| `FaviconSync` | Within one commit every cleanup runs before any effect, so the restore cannot undo a `FaviconSync` write for the new route. Across commits, a late restore writes the same operator URL that `FaviconSync` would write |
| review-tier record | **PASS**, posted on objectui#10372 at head `d10a9ad` |
| semver | `patch` on `@object-ui/layout` |
| CI | 43 check-runs: 40 success, 3 skipped by design, 0 red; `Spec Main Shape Gate` included |
| trailers | Every commit carries the model-free co-author pair only |

### Findings (`out_of_scope_findings`, each with its disposition)

- With an operator favicon configured, `FaviconSync` writes it over an app's branded favicon on every in-app navigation. This is pre-existing: the dev measured it identically on the branch point ⇒ **filed** in this same act.
- `content/docs/layout/app-shell.mdx` says the colour properties are removed on unmount but does not mention the title and favicon restore ⇒ **Acceptance notes**. It is an omission, not a false sentence.
- The hook writes only `href`, while the boot script and `FaviconSync` also set `link.type` by extension ⇒ **Acceptance notes**, an observation only.

### State in this act

`ready` + auto-merge ⇒ merge queue, through the ccr pair. `Fixes #10040` closes this card on merge.
